name: devflow
description: Issue to pull request as Archon runs: devflow-init writes a repository's profile and setup (at most two question rounds, one PR), devflow-refine writes an issue's design (at most two question rounds), devflow-plan publishes its plan, test plan and the parallel build workflow build-issue-<n>, and the unattended build implements and tests the phases, records every decision and stuck phase in deviations.md, runs the definition of done and local CI, and opens one PR carrying the issue's documents, watched until a person merges it; devflow-follow-up continues or corrects a build on a task. Every file follows a template and one mechanical validator, and the issue carries one devflow comment. Plus quick edits, docs review, security audit, a read-only repository configuration review (file fixes through a PR, settings gaps listed for the admin's gh-baseline) and Dependabot repair.
